title: Quick Search — interaction exploration
brief: Explore structurally different interaction models for a focused iOS search app that helps users search and leave instead of falling into a content feed.

variants.name: Quiet Canvas
variants.hypothesis: A nearly chrome-free surface will make search intent and task completion feel immediate.
variants.rationale: Search occupies the visual center while results stay compact and non-feed-like.

variants.name: Thumb Search Dock
variants.hypothesis: A persistent bottom dock can make repeated one-handed searches faster and keep the action anchored.
variants.rationale: Results occupy the upper canvas while the search affordance remains in the thumb zone.

variants.name: Command Results
variants.hypothesis: Results framed as actions rather than cards will encourage completion instead of browsing.
variants.rationale: The result list emphasizes the next action and source destination, with minimal content preview.
